o: Investigations of multiple mysterious and violent cases.

eps.o: When a young father is murdered in his apartment, investigators learn the victim was involved in a bitter custody battle prior to his death.

The search for a missing elderly woman turns into a murder investigation after police discover a grisly crime scene. As authorities search for the last person to see her alive, they follow a digital trail that will expose a cold-hearted betrayal.

An apparent home invasion leaves a woman shot, her boyfriend dead, and police searching for two masked intruders. But when inconsistencies in her story start piling up, police realize the woman at the center might not be the victim she claims to be.

When the decomposed body of a woman is discovered inside a Las Vegas storage unit, investigators follow the clues to an unlikely culprit. A chilling tale of murder unravels, rooted in long-buried family secrets and eerie ties to the occult.

After South Carolina authorities locate a burned and abandoned vehicle, they are led to a brutal crime scene at a local church leader's home. Their small community is divided when an unforeseen perpetrator is found responsible.

A frantic 911 call captures a man's final moments after a brutal knife attack in his home. As their only eyewitness keeps changing her story, investigators dig deep to uncover a crumbling relationship and the sinister truth behind a vicious murder.

When a retired Dauphin County sheriff is found burned to death, investigators zero in on his wife's bizarre behavior. They must quickly determine whether the death was the result of a mental health crisis or a malicious plan to kill.

A missing family man is found murdered in his car near his home in New York. When evidence of a secret affair is exposed, detectives unravel a chilling conspiracy orchestrated by individuals close to him and a mastermind driven by greed.

A respected family man is found shot to death in his upscale California home. As detectives race to find his killer, a startling confession exposes a web of lies, allegations of abuse, and a marriage pushed to its breaking point.

A farmer is gunned down inside his Barron County, Wisconsin home in what appears to be a planned hit. As investigators search for answers, they turn to an unstable ex whose plot to kill shocks the rural community.

A beloved mother is fatally shot after a feud between two other women escalates into a group fight. Pine Bluff authorities interview witnesses to uncover the shooter's true motive as public opinion on the case grows increasingly divided.

Just months after a shooting nearly takes her life, a New Jersey woman is reported missing. Fearing her original attacker has returned to finish the job, investigators race to expose an elaborate murder plot and an obsessive killer

When a businessman collapses in his home under mysterious circumstances, investigators unearth a sinister plot to cover up a multimillion-dollar Ponzi scheme-and the woman who will stop at nothing to keep it hidden.

The family of a respected corrections officer is shattered when they find him in his bed with a fatal gunshot wound. Florida authorities uncover a disgraced former officer whose jealousy and obsession lead to murder.

When a young woman dies from injuries received in an apparent assault, detectives in Georgia open a homicide investigation that reveals infidelity, heartbreak, and the shocking video of a revenge plot gone horribly wrong.

A quiet Florida suburb is shaken by a couple's double homicide, launching detectives into a tense investigation. When evidence points to someone close to the victims, authorities unmask a killer with a tenuous hold on reality.

A South Carolina family is shattered by the sudden disappearance of their daughter just before she planned to launch her dream career. Investigators track her last known movements that will expose a vengeance fueled by a jealous obsession.
When a feud between coworkers in a busy South Carolina restaurant erupts in gunfire, detectives must decide whether the shooting was an act of self-defense or a calculated murder.

When a California sales executive is found shot to death in a parking garage, police initially think it could be a robbery gone wrong. The investigation soon uncovers shocking physical evidence that reveals forbidden liaisons and a deadly scheme.

A Miami-Dade police officer fights for his life after he is shot in front of his parents' house. When surveillance video of the shooting surfaces, detectives home in on a tumultuous relationship marked by violence.

After the brutal murder of a loving grandmother, investigators in Kentucky look to those closest to the victim to uncover the killer. As they examine the evidence, they expose a volatile relationship and a devastating betrayal.

When a woman is shot by a masked gunman in the parking lot of a Colorado Springs recreation center, the evidence points to a premeditated attack. As detectives try to identify the gunman, they uncover a secret affair and a conspiracy to kill.

Beaufort officers suspect foul play after a beloved family man was shot to death while taking a call from an unknown number. The investigation will uncover a string of evidence that exposes a deadly plan to gain control over a toxin.

A series of house fires erupts across Tacoma, Washington, sparking fears of a serial arsonist. When one blaze takes a man's life, investigators rely on video evidence and eyewitness accounts to bring the killer to justice.
